items.title: Intel's Comeback Is Being Paid For By Intel
items.summary: Intel's factories are still losing money on wafers they mostly sell to Intel, and the stock's multiple likely assumes that changes.

items.title: 1 Mega-Cap Stock to Own for Decades and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: Megacap stocks dominate their sectors and their actions influence economies worldwide. The flip side though is that their sheer size means they have less room for explosive growth as scale works against them.

items.title: Trump Calls Micron One of the World’s “Hottest” Companies a Day After Nvidia Disclosed $279 Billion in Supplier Commitments
items.summary: Trump praised Micron as one of the world's hottest companies the day after Nvidia revealed a staggering jump in memory purchase commitments, and the timing raises questions about who stands to benefit most from an AI-driven memory squeeze that insiders say will not ease for years.

items.summary: Supplies of memory chips aren't expected to catch up with demand for at least another year and a half.

items.title: Why Micron Stock Didn’t Get a Leg Up From SK Hynix’s Memory Optimism
items.summary: Good news doesn’t seem to be doing much for  Micron Technology  lately.  Micron shares were down 1.6% at $920.60 in premarket trading.  The stock is down a little over 3% in the past five trading sessions, even after major customer  Nvidia  signaled it will be spending more than ever on memory components next year.
